title: 第13章 监牢小贼第14章 书生意气
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
这段时间，丁字房的普通百姓，进来的数量相对减少了不少，整个监牢也显得有些空旷，将有限的几个牢房送完之后，林铭继续给丙字号监牢送着饭食！
丙字号监牢的犯人，多半都是武林之人！
这些人作奸犯科，可不管你皇帝是不是过寿辰？！
该犯的案子，是一点都没有少！
也幸亏如此，林铭修炼《北冥神功》的事情才一点没有耽误！
“有没有想要出售自身功法，还有其他一切对我有用的东西的！？有的话，快说，根据东西的不同，可以兑换到不同的凡饭食！”
面对林铭的询问，不同的犯人有不同的态度！
“哼！”
这是刚进来的犯人！
还以为自己和在外面的时候一样，是大爷！
进来不是坐牢的，而是来这里享福的！
面对这样的犯人，林铭嘴角浮现出一丝笑容，勺子在木桶里面一搅，直接舀上来两勺清水！
天牢送饭这许多时间，他早就已经练就了一身本领，打饭的时候，说有多少饭粒，就有多少饭粒！
无他！
手熟尔！
这嚣张的犯人，林铭也不和他吵，先饿他三天再说！
多半进入天牢还有嚣张气焰的这些人，饿上三天之后，也就能够明白，自己现在所在的是什么地方？！
明白这里为什么是天牢？！
要是三天之后还不明白？！
简单，再来三天……

饿到他想明白为止！
要是一直想不明白，那就是饿死活该！
天牢之中，什么都贵，唯独人命最便宜，饿死一两个，也只需要上报一个畏罪自杀了事。
将清水打入到对方的饭盆之中，林铭继续向下一个牢房走去。
照例询问，看看有没有人拿自己的功法等物置换饭食。
“大人，小人暂时没有！”
这是已经被饿服了，知道这里是什么地方的犯人！
不少武林之人，犯的罪过都不大，也就是关押几个月时间，就可以出去，多半能忍的情况之下，他们还是不愿意出售自己身上的东西的！
猪食就猪食！
顶多也就几个月时间，忍一忍也就过去了！
林铭有了主修的《北冥神功》，其他功法就并不是特别的着急，有是最好的，没有他也能够认可！
反正他长生不死！
借助天牢这个平台，总是会有人愿意出售自己的东西！
不急！
content_en:
During this period of time, the number of ordinary people entering the D-cell was relatively reduced, and the entire prison seemed a bit empty. After delivering the limited number of cells, Lin Ming continued to deliver meals to the C-cell!
Most of the prisoners in cell No. C are from the martial arts world!
These people commit crimes, but they don't care whether your emperor is celebrating his birthday? !
There is no shortage of cases that should be committed!
Fortunately, Lin Ming's practice of the "Bei Ming Divine Art" was not delayed at all!
"Do you want to sell your skills and other things that are useful to me!? If so, please tell me. Depending on the items, you can exchange them for different kinds of food!"
Facing Lin Ming's questioning, different prisoners had different attitudes!
"Hmph!"
This is the prisoner who just came in!
I thought I was the same uncle as when I was outside!
You don’t come here to go to jail, you come here to enjoy happiness!
Facing such a prisoner, a smile appeared on Lin Ming's lips. He stirred the wooden bucket with a spoon and scooped up two spoonfuls of water!
During the many hours spent delivering meals in Tianlao, he had already developed a skill. When delivering meals, he would get as many grains of rice as he was told!
Without him!
You are familiar with it!
Lin Ming didn't want to argue with this arrogant prisoner. He would starve him for three days first!
Most of these people who entered the heavenly prison with arrogance and arrogance will be able to understand where they are now after three days of starvation. !
Do you understand why this is a prison? !
What if you still don’t understand after three days? !
Simple, just three more days...
Hungry until he figures it out!
If you still can’t figure it out, you deserve to starve to death!
In the prison, everything is expensive, but human life is the cheapest. If one or two starve to death, you only need to report one to commit suicide out of fear of crime.
After pouring the water into the opponent's rice bowl, Lin Ming continued to walk to the next cell.
Ask as usual to see if anyone has exchanged their own exercises and other items for meals.
"Sir, I don't have one for now!"
This is a prisoner who has been starved and knows where this place is!
Many people in the martial arts world have committed relatively minor crimes, that is, they can be released after being detained for a few months. Most of them can tolerate it, but they are still unwilling to sell their belongings!
Pig food is pig food!
It will only last a few months at most, and it will pass if you endure it!
Now that Lin Ming has mastered the "Bei Ming Divine Technique", he is not particularly anxious about other techniques. It is the best and can be recognized without him!
He is immortal anyway!
With the help of the Tianlao platform, there will always be people willing to sell their things!
No rush!
